title: Christophe
content: I did this portrait in a bistro while waiting for the salad. Christophe Curien is an painter/sculptor from Paris. He was concentrating on watching the drawing, so he has a rather serious expression.I used two or three water-soluble colored pencils, and I painted the background with a water brush filled with fountain-pen ink.-------Thanks, Christophe and Michael.Christophe's website
